artifact_observations.reasoning: The bottom end of the metal spine mechanism appears to melt or fuse into the white background without a clear termination point or shadow. It lacks the physical thickness expected of a metal hinge.
The black texture is unnaturally uniform and noisy, lacking the subtle grain or reflection variations typical of vinyl or paper linings.
The geometry of the ring clamps is slightly inconsistent; the holes appear elliptical but the surrounding metal doesn't follow a consistent perspective vanishing point, looking slightly warped.
